answer: Identity bonds that decay naturally stop sybil scale. Each agent locks a 50 POA bond that shrinks 5% every epoch unless renewed by distinct useful work. A public beacon publishes the decay table at dawn, so no one can hide a frozen bond. Sybil farms flare like a comet, bright for one epoch then gone: 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA and keep paying to stay alive, while an honest agent pays once and renews with real work.
